rejection_reason_raw: Missing API declaration - Your app's code references APIs requiring reasons
fix_summary: 在 PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy 的 NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes 中声明对应 API category + reason code

rejection_reason_raw: Invalid privacy manifest - The PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy file is invalid
fix_summary: 检查 PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy plist 格式（plutil -lint），确认所有 key 为官方定义的 NSPrivacy* 键且 value 类型正确

rejection_reason_raw: Your app includes 'Frameworks/MBProgressHUD.framework/MBProgressHUD', which includes MBProgressHUD, an SDK that was identified in the documentation as a privacy-impacting third-party SDK. Starting November 12, 2024, new apps including such SDKs must have valid privacy manifest files.
fix_summary: 升级 SDK 到带 privacy manifest 的版本；若作者未维护可 fork 后补 PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy；社区工具 app_privacy_manifest_fixer 可自动修复

rejection_reason_raw: We noticed that your app requires users to register with personal information to purchase in-app purchase products that are not account based. Apps cannot require user registration prior to allowing access to app content and features that are not associated specifically to the user.
fix_summary: 去掉入口页强制登录；登录提示移到购买/解锁按钮；提供访客模式或匿名账户

rejection_reason_raw: We noticed your app shares a similar binary, metadata, and/or concept as apps previously submitted by a terminated Apple Developer Program account.
fix_summary: 改 App name + description；截图换为真实运行截图；调整 metadata；必要时跨多个版本改动（审核员会加严）
notes: 4.3 常见触发：同源码改 logo 打马甲；付费 App 模板；社交/算命饱和赛道

rejection_reason_raw: (文中未完整引用 Apple 原文) Apple 误判 App 使用第三方支付解锁软件功能；实际为硬件费用结算。
fix_summary: 在订单页面补文案明确区分硬件费 vs App 功能；Review Notes 说明用途；附硬件合同照片作为证据
notes: Guideline 3.1.3(e) 允许物理商品/服务用非 IAP，但必须在 Review Notes 说明

rejection_reason_raw: BeadSnap (com.beadsnap.ai) v1.0.2 NSUserTrackingUsageDescription = 'This allows us to personalize beauty content and makeup recommendations for you, and help us bring more users like you to FaceFlow' / NSCameraUsageDescription = 'Capture photos and analyze your facial features' — 拼豆 App 但权限文案完全是 FaceFlow 化妆 App 模板 fork 残留
fix_summary: 全工程 grep 替换 'FaceFlow' / 'facial features' / 'beauty content' / 'makeup' → 改为本 App 的精确业务文案 (e.g., 'Capture photos to convert into pixel bead patterns')
notes: RQ 打样调研 IJCBRW Top 3 模式之一：模板 fork 字符串残留。BeadSnap 已上架说明 ASR 自动审过了，但人工二审/后续版本会被发现

rejection_reason_raw: Stylab (com.stylab.app) v1.0.1 Tell Friends 分享 sheet 显示 'Tell friends about CoKnit' (而非 Stylab) — UIActivityViewController title/subject 字段未替换 sister-app 文案
fix_summary: grep 'CoKnit' 全工程，全部替换为本 App 名；包括 Smart Tool placeholder 'Chat about knitting' 等
notes: PIXELCELL PTE. LIMITED 工厂模式：sister apps 共享 SwiftUI 模板，复用代码时未全量替换 brand 字符串。开发者同时拥有 Stylab/CoKnit/BakeWay/ComicNani 多个 App

rejection_reason_raw: ComicNani (com.comic.ai) v1.0.0 Free 用户点 Create Comic → 后端永远返回 Failed 状态，无前置 'need premium' 提示。Apple 审核员手动测试时会判 4.2 minimum functionality 不足 + 3.1.2(c) 误导用户 + 2.1 completeness 综合拒
fix_summary: Free 用户的核心 CTA 必须在点击前判定权限：(a) Disable + tooltip 'Upgrade to Premium' / (b) tap → 直接弹 paywall (不走后端 create) / (c) Review Notes 说明 'Free tier supports X, Premium unlocks Y'
notes: Free 路径完整度 (D5) 反例。也是 ComicNani speckit 扫描覆盖率仅 56% 的根因 — 核心生成功能在 free 状态下走不通

rejection_reason_raw: BeadSnap onboarding 6 marketing 屏承诺 4 项功能 (Virtual Inventory/Creator Marketplace/Pricing Calculator/Collector Profile)，但 v1.0.2 App 内无任何菜单入口 — 4 项疑似 vaporware
fix_summary: 对照 speckit feature-checklist：onboarding 承诺的每个 feature 必须有 in-app entry；vaporware 项要么实现，要么从 onboarding 移除
notes: Apple 人工审核会按 onboarding 卡片逐个找入口；找不到 → 4.2 拒。这是打样 App 工厂模式的常见反例：营销页超前于功能

rejection_reason_raw: Stylab (com.stylab.app) 每次 cold launch 都强制弹 paywall — 免费用户必须每次手动 tap 右上 X 才能进 Home。Apple 3.2.1 'frequent prompts to upgrade' 风险
fix_summary: Paywall 触发逻辑加 'isFirstLaunch || hasCompletedOnboarding' 条件；改成 day-N 触发 (第 3 次启动 / 试用结束前 1 天) 而非每次冷启动
notes: Paywall 漏斗合规 (D6) 反例。已上架但用户体验高风险，DAU/MAU 留存可能受损
